name: Change Of Venue
overview: In Acts 23:17-22, we see a strategic change of venue initiated by Paul through a young man who warns the chief captain of a deadly plot against him. This passage highlights how Paul, while under threat, employs wisdom and divine providence to protect his life by informing authorities of the danger. The chief captain's response to keep the matter confidential demonstrates careful discretion in handling sensitive information. This account reveals the importance of discerning when to seek a change of venue for safety and the preservation of God's purposes.
